notes.title: DUELIST V1.3.0 CHRISTMAS UPDATE
notes.content:
Hey Duelists we are here with new content update. This will be all for this year as we are coming close to end of 2021 so see you at 2022. Happy Duels!

Duelist V1.3.0
New Features:
-Christmas Update
-Emotes
-Duel Mod
-Lighting System V1.0
-Couch CO-OP

We had a wonderful year for duelist and game is improving slowly. We will continue our game updates in 2022 so stay in touch. You can always check our roadmap from here :

[url=https://trello.com/b/w5nCPMtR/roadmap]ROADMAP[/url]

HAPPY NEW YEAR!

notes.title: DUELIST V1.2.0 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
Hey Duelists we are here with new content update. We wanted give customization and a new game mod (SALOON) in this update. Here is the new content in this update.

Duelist V1.2.0
New Features:
-Bug Report System
-Character Customization
-New Main Menu
-Saloon and Saloon Tutorial (Blackjack,Russian Roulette)
-Better Loading System

We will start working on Duelist 1.3.0 . You can always check our roadmap from in-game. Here is planned features for V1.3.0:

Duelist V1.3.0
-Network Optimization V1.1.0
-New Theme (Modern Day)
-Duel Mod And Tutorial
-Emotes

See you at the next update. Happy Duels :)

notes.title: DUELIST V1.1.0 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
Hey Duelists we hope you are doing well. We have good news for you. We finished first update of the duelist "YEY". Here is content what you will expect new in this update.

Duelist V1.1.0
New Features:
-New Theme Medieval
-New Weather Condition Snow
-Able To Change Lobby Name
-New Filtering (WORLD WIDE,FAR,MID RANGE,CLOSE) For Matchmaking
-Network Optimization V1.0.0

Fixed Bugs:
-Able To Run In PowerSaber Lock


We will start working on Duelist 1.2.0 . You can always check our roadmap from in-game. Here is planned features for V1.2.0:

Duelist V1.2.0
-Bug Report System
-Character Customization
-Duel Mod
-Tutorial

See you at the next update. Happy Duels :)
